symptom: Two successful native Director responses each decoded 15 write_file calls, yet DEO dispatched zero calls and projected every member as deo_tool_normalization_failed. The target workspace retained only catalog and requirements scaffolding.

dynamic_test_reproduction.before_fix: 5 passed, then test_snapshot_and_revalidation_denials_have_full_zero_effect_matrix[binding] failed because snapshot.allowed was false with deo_tool_normalization_failed

root_cause.detail: DirectorEffectPolicySnapshotPort reuses DirectorToolExecutor._validate_director_policy_for_write as an unbound evidence-only preview. The r16 physical-scope hardening directly read self._authorized_scope, but the policy snapshot port intentionally does not own that physical executor field. Every preview raised AttributeError, which the snapshot boundary correctly collapsed to deo_tool_normalization_failed; all candidates were therefore soft-denied before dispatch.
root_cause.false_attribution_prevented: The downstream blank-content retry diagnostic inspected error receipts after DEO denial and incorrectly suggested model blank writes, although immutable kernel turn outcomes retained substantial non-empty content.

implementation.behavior: The shared write-policy validator uses the physical executor's bound scope only when that private field exists; otherwise the evidence-only snapshot port consumes request-carried capability scope. Snapshot normalization failures now log tool, target, exception type, and exception message without logging file content.

safety_invariants: No generated Bench target was modified.
Undeclared paths remain denied by the same capability policy.
The snapshot port remains evidence-only and performs no physical effect.
Ordinary Director failures remain in the same Director task; PM and Chief Engineer are not restarted.

verification.broader_regression: 200 passed across policy snapshot, mutation port, execution tools, mutation guard, KernelGuard, and tool-batch decision tree
